description: Remove a custom port mapping from a specific instance (by id or exact name). The public port is freed immediately and anything connecting through it stops working. Game-required ports cannot be removed. Call get_connection_info first and show the user the mapping you are about to remove. Port mappings apply to shared-IP servers only.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be deleted, naming the internal port and the public port it frees and getting their approval.

container.description: The internal port of the mapping to delete, from get_connection_info.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: delete_port
title: Delete Port Mapping
